name: Astrid & Miyu
description: London contemporary jewelry brand founded in 2012, known for ear stacking and piercing jewelry. It runs its own creator community, Astrid & You, with affiliate links and commission, alongside a network affiliate program.

evidence.summary: The brand's own Astrid & You page (fetched) advertises 'Up to 15% commission' through a personal affiliate link. 'Up to 15%' is a rate ceiling with no published floor, so commission_rate is recorded as null.
